title: TEJAURA Agent Contract
description: Schema for a governed TEJAURA agent definition, capability ceiling, allowed tools, and model preferences.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the agent.

department.description: Functional domain or department to which the agent belongs.

role.description: Concise functional role of the agent.

description.description: Plain-language explanation of the agent's responsibilities and boundaries.

status.description: Operational lifecycle state of the agent.

enabled.description: Whether the agent is currently permitted to accept tasks.

permitted_autonomy_level.description: Maximum TEJAURA autonomy level assignable to this agent (L0-L3 only; L4 is permanently owner-exclusive).

allowed_tool_ids.description: Explicit allowlist of registered tool IDs this agent may request or invoke.

preferred_model_ids.description: Ordered list of registered model IDs preferred for this agent (must reference intelligence/model-registry/models.json entries).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the agent record was created.

schema_version.description: Optional semantic version of this agent contract.
